causal_stages.validation_limit: Структурный validator не запускает tests и не доказывает математику; нового runtime/scientific PASS здесь нет.

causal_stages.validation_limit: Структурный validator не запускает tests и не доказывает математику; нового runtime/scientific PASS здесь нет.

e02_findings.residual_scope: Production empty-seed search→enrich already carries content-addressed bytes: the API persists the WebEvidenceBundle, resolves the selected source to `SourceSpec(kind=bytes)`, reads CAS content by ArtifactID and verifies digest/size; `_acquire_bytes` verifies again without URL re-fetch. The remaining defect is source-metadata binding. `build_source_metadata` copies content digest/type but omits the same FetchResult’s ArtifactRef/artifact_id, byte_size, final_url, redirect_chain, ETag, Last-Modified, license, fetch_profile, lineage_parent_artifact_id and refresh_reason. SourceMetadata derives only an ArtifactID from the digest; the other fields stay at defaults. `_source_spec_from_snapshot` fills missing artifact_id, final_url, redirect_chain, ETag, Last-Modified, fetch_profile, refresh lineage, byte_size and license from `cache.get(source_url)`, which is the URL’s current record rather than the retained source snapshot. A retained v1 can therefore keep v1 bytes while inheriting same-URL v2 metadata; if v2 byte_size differs, the API rejects the valid v1 bytes. The handoff also reduces full ArtifactRef to ArtifactID, losing kind/media_type/manifest_profile_sha256. The live fetcher leaves effective fetch_profile at its default `{}`; DocSourceSpec/DocMeta do not persist fetch profile or refresh lineage, and WebEvidenceBundle retains only fields its producer supplied. Residual: bind ArtifactRef, digest, final URL/redirects/headers/license/size/effective fetch profile/refresh lineage to the same FetchResult through the persisted consumer. Prove v1 no-egress replay, same-URL v2 isolation and lineage, current-cache mutation does not contaminate/refuse v1, plus typed missing/access failure. Keep partial; behavioral and four-base evidence remain UNRUN.

causal.title: Stage 2.1 — Identifiability preservation under latent interface variables
causal.reason: Preserve the exact composed latent projection and each query witness. Human-approved bridge semantics does not itself establish preservation. Reuse supported reconciliation; a new latent-interface question requires its own joint model and proof.

causal.title: Stage 3.1 — Sharpness proofs for complex query families
causal.reason: LP dual feasibility and sharpness apply to the represented compatible-model set. Binary variables, a small optimization gap or interval intersection alone do not establish exact model encoding or joint compatibility.

causal.title: Stage 4.4 — Dynamic SCM semantics and σ-separation for proof kernel
causal.reason: Reuse validated linear-unique cyclic reductions and typed dynamic semantics. Do not revive the older SCC-condensation heuristic as a general ioID implementation; solvability, intervention closure and identification are separate.

causal.title: Stage 5.3 — Extending the proof kernel to distributional estimands
causal.reason: Distributional ID is not an entirely new theory: ID/IDC already identify suitable interventional distributions. The repository now carries marginal-law proofs separately from coupling. Do not rebuild an obsolete scenario-only prerequisite.

causal.title: Stage 8.1 — Algebraic model testing beyond conditional independence
causal.reason: Reuse declared beyond-CI families and severity semantics. Algebraic compatibility is conditional on model class, sampling and calibration; a failure concerns that class, while non-rejection does not validate it.

causal.title: Stage 11.1 — Machine-checkable proximal identification certificates
causal.reason: Reuse sound-but-incomplete PCI-Core. Proxy roles, bridge existence and completeness cannot be inferred from a graph label or a numerical solution alone. Failure outside scope is not universal non-identification.

causal.title: Stage 11.2 — Bridge function existence and completeness conditions
causal.reason: This stage appears twice in CR but counts once. Reuse typed bridge-plausibility/fallback. Existence, nonuniqueness and ill-posedness differ; an ATE can be invariant across nonunique bridges. A green residual/rank diagnostic is not a general completeness proof.

causal.title: Stage 12.1 — Recoverability certificates for proof kernel integration
causal.reason: Reuse currently emitted joint ID/recoverability verdicts. Full-law failure need not block a recoverable target; failure of a sufficient recovery search is not a complete impossibility certificate.

causal.title: Stage 13.1 — Formal intervention type system for proof kernel
causal.reason: Reuse typed intervention families and natural-dependency restrictions. Conditioning, a dynamic policy and a transformation of natural treatment are different targets even if they share input fields.

causal.title: Stage 15.1 — Identification conditions under DP-distorted distributions
causal.reason: Reuse DP robustness attachment for declared proof classes. A fixed graph’s identification statement, utility from private releases and privacy accounting differ. Noise error around an empirical statistic is not total population uncertainty.

causal.title: Stage 16.1 — Formal conditions for ICP-based MEC contraction
causal.reason: Reuse the declared nonlinear additive-noise ICP slice. Context exogeneity, target mechanism stability, informative environments, screening and finite-sample calibration are essential. A smaller graph is not itself a better policy answer.

causal.title: Phase 2 — Query expansion and first production-facing upgrades
causal.reason: Historical architecture, evidence discipline or owner interface; consume current canonical owners and scoped declarations instead of rebuilding the plan.

causal.title: Stage 2.2 — Transfer of do-calculus derivations across fragment boundaries
causal.reason: Reuse derivation transfer and replay. Query, graph, assumptions, projection and rule identity must remain valid; an equal witness fingerprint is a sufficient reuse check within its owner, not a general necessity theorem.

causal.title: Stage 3.2 — Automated bound tightening with soundness guarantees
causal.reason: Reuse bound tightening with assumption-indexed alternatives, feasible-set checks, budget exits and replay. A solver cannot admit a new monotonicity, instrument or cross-world premise by discovering a narrower interval.

causal.title: Stage 5.1 — Causally justified OT couplings under partial identification
causal.reason: Keep OT as a licensed sidecar to marginal laws. Wasserstein comparisons can be functions of marginals, while the optimizer coupling is not an identified cross-world law or an individual gain map.

causal.title: Stage 5.2 — Bounded distributional effects for tail risk and subgroup shifts
causal.reason: Reuse the supported Lee/Makarov functionals. Distinguish selection/always-observed populations, marginal coupling restrictions, atoms, pointwise sharpness, whole-curve sharpness and statistical simultaneous coverage.

causal.title: Stage 6.1 — Equilibrium computation for complex strategic environments
causal.reason: Reuse supported game classes and explicit equilibrium sets/selection. Existence, computation, multiplicity, behavioral validity and policy value are different questions. A model solver does not empirically validate payoffs or behavior.

causal.title: Stage 7.2 — Conditions for faithful micro-to-macro causal transport
causal.reason: Reuse supported aggregation classes. Means and linear welfare under declared exchangeability/closure can be preserved while within-cell tails, inequality, heterogeneity and individual best responses are not.

causal.title: Stage 8.2 — Finite-sample algebraic model testing under noise and misspecification
causal.reason: The archive calls thresholds provisional synthetic recommendations. Runtime described at CR4020–4022 distinguishes sufficient sample/draw/corroboration regimes. Repository closure is not calibration on every authentic source family.

causal.title: Stage 9.1 — Latent variable cardinality identification from distributional shifts
causal.reason: The archive calls ME-LiNGLaH-S a theorem candidate. Current closure describes machine-readable promotion evidence for supported shift families, not proof of arbitrary latent cardinality from data.

causal.title: Stage 9.2 — Separating latent confounding, proxy mismatch, and measurement error
causal.reason: Reuse the scoped split among confounding, proxy mismatch and measurement error. Repeated indicators, proxy families, stable mechanisms and alternative explanations are load-bearing. Preserve mixed and unresolved outputs.

causal.title: Stage 10.1 — Simplicial complex identification theory for interference
causal.reason: Keep supported pairwise/cluster scope unless a concrete higher-order question needs extension. The archive’s star-local simplicial proposal requires meaningful group structure, assignment, exposure consistency and positivity; adding artificial faces does not validate a hypergraph.

causal.title: Stage 11.2 — Bridge function existence and completeness conditions
causal.reason: This stage appears twice in CR but counts once. Reuse typed bridge-plausibility/fallback. Existence, nonuniqueness and ill-posedness differ; an ATE can be invariant across nonunique bridges. A green residual/rank diagnostic is not a general completeness proof.

causal.title: Stage 12.2 — Recoverability under administrative and selective missingness
causal.reason: Reuse administrative missingness templates. Registration frames, compliance logs, system versions and rollout metadata are concrete acquisition requirements. Missing objects, missing attributes and not-applicable values must remain distinct.

causal.title: Stage 13.2 — Identification and estimation for stochastic and modified treatment policies
causal.reason: Keep accepted single-target stochastic/MTP scope. An incremental intervention can be a useful separately named policy under weak overlap, but cannot silently replace the requested intervention as an estimator fallback.

causal.title: Stage 15.2 — Conditional independence tests calibrated for DP noise
causal.reason: Reuse mechanism-aware DP-CI and threshold resolution. Curator counts, noisy rows and private output are different experiments. Approximate residual-KCI does not inherit a generic dpHSIC theorem merely by naming it.

causal.title: Stage 16.2 — Distinguishing regime shifts from latent confounding
causal.reason: Retain diagnostic consistency/ambiguity labels and external context evidence. CR5703’s claimed false-certification bound does not follow from prior Type-I false-rejection bounds alone; see explicit counterexample. No current-code correctness verdict is inferred.

causal.title: Phase 3 — Dependency-driven advanced integration
causal.reason: Historical architecture, evidence discipline or owner interface; consume current canonical owners and scoped declarations instead of rebuilding the plan.

causal.title: Stage 2.3 — Cyclic SCM fragment composition
causal.reason: Reuse internal cyclic fragments with admitted solution/intervention-closure witnesses and sigma-aware audit. Cross-fragment feedback, initial-condition dependence and other semantics remain rational scope limits.

causal.title: Stage 4.1 — Causal semantics for rough-path and irregular sampling regimes
causal.reason: April 20 describes a real irregular-grid rough-path lane. Reuse it with declared observation/lift, adapted interpolation, continuation, support and target functional. Represented-path validity does not become latent-process validity without the additional equivalence premise.

causal.title: Stage 4.2 — Identification theory for neural SDE / neural CDE
causal.reason: Supported neural SDE/CDE classes are a legitimate narrow scope. Predictive fit or universal approximation does not supply full-state observability, law-invariant intervention semantics or no-hidden-confounding premises.

causal.title: Stage 4.3 — Conditions for valid discrete-to-continuous causal translation
causal.reason: Reuse translation certificates. Numerical grid agreement is separate from intervention-preserving abstraction. A non-fallback solver route alone does not establish causal equivalence; node-value preservation does not automatically cover integrals or hitting times.

causal.title: Stage 4.5 — Local independence and Granger-causal semantics in continuous time
causal.reason: Reuse event-process intensity weighting with causal validity, censoring, eliminability and absolute-continuity premises. Local/Granger independence alone is not a policy effect; a sufficient rule’s failure need not mean impossibility.

causal.title: Stage 6.2 — Performative prediction convergence and instability
causal.reason: Reuse performative stability artifacts. Failure of a sufficient contraction bound is inconclusive, not proof of divergence; estimated Jacobians and finite simulations have their own scope. Convergence is not welfare optimality, and a randomized mixture is a distinct policy.

causal.title: Stage 6.3 — Decomposition of post-policy outcome into causal and strategic components
causal.reason: April 20 explicitly materializes exact, selector-invariant, bounded and blocked decomposition. Reuse these outputs. Frozen-baseline cross-world feasibility and equilibrium correspondence must be meaningful; deterministic tie-breaking is not scientific selection.

causal.title: Stage 6.4 — Mean Field Game equilibrium for macro-policy causal inference
causal.reason: Reuse the declared mean-field lane and anonymous-aggregative epsilon-Nash scope. The much broader HJB/FP/SCM synthesis in historical prose is not established by that label. Primitive calibration, branch selection and causal identification remain explicit.

causal.title: Stage 7.1 — Approximate abstraction error bounds for continuous and non-finite models
causal.reason: Continuous linear-Gaussian and Lipschitz-DAG verifiers, persistence and consumers are described as implemented at CR7667–7675. Use query-value error budgets. A ranking gap above twice the abstraction bound controls abstraction error only, not all inferential or normative uncertainty.

causal.title: Stage 8.3 — Semialgebraic negative certificates and SCM class incompatibility
causal.reason: Reuse supported binary-IV/semialgebraic incompatibility routes. Statistical rejection, an exact infeasibility witness and non-identification are distinct. General Groebner/SOS expansion is an option only for a named class and payoff.

causal.title: Stage 10.2 — Exposure-complex estimators with honest pairwise fallback
causal.reason: Reuse explicit mode selection and fallback. A coarsened exposure effect answers a different question unless an exact reduction is established. The richest available family need not be the best product default.

causal.title: Stage 10.3 — Bounds on reduction error from hypergraph to pairwise projection
causal.reason: Reuse scoped reduction-error bounds. The triangle/count result is design-rate-specific; each Bernoulli rate uses its own calibrated operator and actual response/Lipschitz premises. It is not a universal topology or sampling-error bound.

causal.title: Stage 11.3 — Proximal mediation and path-specific proximal effects
causal.reason: April 20 describes single_mediator_proximal_v1, typed oracle acceptance, approximate nested linear bridges and bounds fallback. Reuse it; mediator-specific proxy exclusions, cross-world assumptions and bridge scope still require substantive support.

causal.title: Stage 12.3 — Compile-time recovery strategy selection
causal.reason: April 20 selector and recursive lowering supersede old missing-lowering instructions. Choose only estimators licensed by the recovery formula. Factorwise plug-in is not automatically globally efficient EIF estimation; complete-case averaging is not a general MAR fallback.

causal.title: Stage 13.3 — Path-specific and edge-specific effect identification at scale
causal.reason: April 20 describes district-local DAG/ADMG proof, conditional pre-treatment queries, experiments, witness bounds and proximal templates. Reuse. Width, frontier and representation determine scale; node count alone does not guarantee tractability.

causal.title: Stage 15.3 — Transportability and recoverability under DP distortion
causal.reason: Reuse privacy-aware transport/recovery. Public mechanism, released factors, support, clipping and utility bounds matter, not epsilon alone. Sufficient tolerance bounds are not necessary-and-sufficient conditions; interval overlap alone does not prove invariance.

causal.title: Stage 16.3 — Computational tractability and Foundry integration
causal.reason: Reuse instance-scoped discovery feasibility. Pruning must preserve the admitted model class and reflect calibration uncertainty; non-rejected tetrads do not alone prove a pure measurement block. Arbitrary 100-node exactness is not established.

causal.reason: Historical architecture, evidence discipline or owner interface; consume current canonical owners and scoped declarations instead of rebuilding the plan.

causal_optional_growth.title: Восстановить пригодный ответ из административно неполных данных
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Для фиксированного населения и исхода определить, какой конкретный target recoverable при регистрации, комплаенсе или смене системы, и получить пригодный estimate/bound.
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один frozen panel, один target mean/contrast, явная population frame и missingness mechanism. Сравнить ручную формулу и существующий recovery selector на тех же строках.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Другая missingness family или source/target transport с неполным, но пригодным target law.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Нужны denominator и непопавшие объекты, индикаторы наблюдения, eligibility/compliance/status logs, system-version/rollout, joint measured covariates; административное основание стрелок и support. Количество NA не заменяет эти объекты.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: RecoverabilityCertificate, RecoveredDistNode, recovery_strategy_selector и canonical Scientist consumer. Свежий Ukraine selected-input contract имеет один panel workflow и двенадцать routed residuals; inspected selected panel DTO синтетический, хотя observation parquet сохраняется отдельно. Authentic input construction требует точного frozen payload. Не строить12consumer routes заново в Foundry.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Полные случаи без коррекции и простой MAR IPW/standardization, если их premises действительно допустимы. Negative: selection-only rows без population frame; positive: recoverable target при нереконструируемом full law.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Переоформить, если новая запись не меняет target recoverability или полезную ширину; не собирать весь корпус ради неподходящего nuisance. Broad automated EIF — отдельная отложенная опция.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Сравнивать распределения и пределы индивидуальных выгод
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Различать сдвиг маргинального распределения, tail functional и неопределённость распределения индивидуальных gains.
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один identified/bounded marginal contrast с tail/quantile question; рядом показать Makarov/другой допустимый envelope вместо произвольного coupling.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Selection/always-observed population или два условных subgroup distributions с разными support/atom patterns.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Исходы и единицы, population weights, assignment/selection, support, source-family dependence и joint/coupling evidence ровно там, где target его требует. Normative tail criterion задаётся отдельно.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: Distributional proof, BoundsBundle и coupling sidecar; DS16 value/recipe/outer-set consumers после относящихся E02 repairs. Не выдавать OT optimizer за людей, переместившихся по rank.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Empirical distribution / quantiles с ручным marginal proof и простыми bounds. Negative: одинаковые marginals с разными совместными potential outcomes.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Остановить усложнение, если вопрос решается means/quantiles или interval не меняет допустимый выбор; полную cross-world joint law не считать обязательной.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Отвечать о времени действия и наблюдения
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Когда появляется эффект, как меняются cumulative outcome и transient harm при конкретном schedule или intensity rule?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один фиксированный schedule на regular/declared irregular grid, effect_path либо integral_effect, с observed sampling/censoring mechanism и ручным linear/discrete comparator.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Counting-process question с intensity replacement и censoring; только затем новая функциональная семья вроде hitting time, если её требует пользователь.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Time scale, timestamps, exposure/history, actionability, sampling/observation process, censoring/risk sets, continuation rule; causal identification и represented-versus-latent path premise.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: CausalEngine.temporal_causal_effect, TemporalExecutionPlan, RoughPathInterventionCertificate, separate event weighting and DTR policy/derived-schedule artifacts. Реальная causal adaptation не выводится из toy solver.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Linear SDE/ODE or explicit discrete replay at same target; negative future-leaking interpolation and changed observation grid.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Не переходить к neural/rough backend ради fit alone. Если простой schedule отвечает на вопрос, сохранить узкую поддержку; hitting/occupancy/general dynamic paths — опции, не debts.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Сравнивать политику с учётом реакции и масштаба
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Как меняется total policy value при допустимых ответах агентов, multiplicity и агрегации, и устойчив ли вывод к выбранной модели?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Конечное меню policy/actions и небольшой game с явно stipulated либо отдельно обоснованными payoff/response primitives; exact enumeration and equilibrium-set disclosure.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Тот же target на подтверждённой aggregation class, затем эмпирически калиброванный response/lag case; MFG лишь при реальной population-scale потребности.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Action/payoff/constraint definitions, response data или честные stipulations, equilibrium selection basis, intervention scope, aggregation errors и value criterion. Численное равновесие не подтверждает поведение.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: StrategicResponseBundle, decomposition correspondence, PerformativeShiftSummary, AbstractionCertificate and existing mean-field scope. E02 service/covariance/uncertainty repairs consumed once.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Exact finite enumeration and passive model side by side; negatives changed action semantics, multiple selectors, gap below abstraction error.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Стоп, если ценность зависит от неподтверждённого behavior больше чем от решения; не превращать finite demonstration в обещание реального fiscal effect.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Использовать qualified latent measurement вместо красивого fit
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Устраняет ли новая measurement/proxy family конкретную неоднозначность конструкции или causal question без выдуманного latent meaning?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один measurement construct, независимые indicators/anchors и rival model; reuse proposal/diagnostic/promotion owner, затем bounded downstream consumption.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Независимая environment family или внешний perturbation/anchor, меняющий prediction по заданному mechanism.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Raw indicator instrument, sampling, invariance/DIF/anchor evidence, proxy exclusions, source independence и independent human/benchmark decision. Название латента требует внешнего semantic evidence.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: LatentBridgeHypothesis, LatentDiscoveryBundle and Stage9.3 promotion authority. E1/E2 scientific support is distinct from signed admission; O1/O3 mutation remains separate.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: No-new-latent alternative: measurement mismatch, correlated error, selection, partial noninvariance; held-out difference and useful downstream bounds.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Не повышать статус из non-rejection alone. Если две модели неразличимы, сохранить ambiguity; широкую latent cardinality theory не делать обязательным project.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Оценивать конкретные group exposure эффекты
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Влияет ли изменение allocation на соседей/группу и какой exposure contrast действительно поддержан design?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Known cluster или pairwise network, один effect с assignment probability/support и uncertainty appropriate to dependence.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Реальная group-activation hypothesis, которую pairwise mapping не выражает; лишь тогда поддержанный higher-order scope или отдельный extension decision.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Group roster/topology, treatment assignment, time and interference horizon, exposure mapping, risk/support probabilities, outcomes and dependence regime. Synthetic cells не являются observed household joints.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: InteractionComplex, InterferenceCertificate, current estimators and reduction bounds; preserve mode_requested/mode_used and exact new estimand.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Cluster/pairwise IPW/AIPW with same design; negative aliases between higher-order and lower-order exposures, unsupported rare cells.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Не выбирать richest topology по умолчанию. Если coarsening меняет вопрос, выдать отдельно названную альтернативу; отсутствие общего hypergraph theorem не является defect.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Получать доказательно пригодное основание у внешнего holder
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Какой запрос можно оценить из конкретного private release, и какие данные/статистики лучше запросить без лишнего disclosure?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один существующий release с public mechanism и target formula; mechanism-aware interval и simple published-statistic comparator.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Два домена с неодинаковыми release channels; target expression может быть пригодна даже без отдельного восстановления всех factors.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Actual holder rights/access, release mechanism, clipping/sensitivity/accountant, domain/population/version, support and utility contract. Privacy budget не является truth confidence.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: DP robustness, privacy transport, threshold registry and holder/acquisition owners; не создавать новый privacy subsystem.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Ручная post-processing formula с явным noise model; negative unknown synthetic mechanism, noisy rare denominator, graph inferred from private data.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Отложить до реального holder/question. Не запрашивать sensitive payload или запускать private experiment ради architecture demo; большие theoretical privacy generalizations не обязательны.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Давать исполнимые варианты действий вместо feature edits
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Какая доступная программа действий минимальной цены достигает объявленной цели в поддержанной causal semantics?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Finite action menu, stipulated model and costs, exact graph-search comparator; ясно model-conditional, без персональных решений о реальных людях.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Реальный action channel с temporal/prerequisite constraints и uncertainty-aware bounded recourse; индивидуальный claim только при отдельном основании.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Actionability, mutable/immutable constraints, actual cost/availability/authority, factual/subpopulation semantics, structural equations and success uncertainty.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: Existing recourse query/manifold/feasibility artifacts plus action grammar and human consumer. General nonlinear heuristic stays non-promotable.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Enumerate all finite actions; negative impossible income intervention, changed domain/prerequisite, target attained only in average subgroup.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Не путать feasible-in-model с executable-in-world; не добавлять generic manifold optimizer когда конечное меню достаточно.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Использовать структурированные outcomes без смены identification
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Как меняется выбранное пространство trajectory/distribution probes при уже идентифицированной политике?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Один backdoor query, bounded output kernel, finite audit probes и простой scalar-per-probe comparator.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Материально иной structured outcome либо supported transport/kernel template; whole-space lift только с соответствующим uniform proof.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Outcome-space/units, kernel and probe definitions, support, regularization/nuisance protocol, uncertainty target. Не каждый finite basis поддерживает whole-space claim.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: KernelEstimatorSpec, KernelLoweringPass, OperatorTarget/Apply and persisted Scientist sinks. Reuse opt-in lane; kernel-specific OOF gate respected.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Hand-selected meaningful probes and standard estimators; negatives non-characteristic representation presented as full distribution, unsupported inverse operator.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Если scientific gain отсутствует относительно простых probes, оставить finite basis. Full-operator CI and policy derivative operators — deferred option, не mandatory debt.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

causal_optional_growth.title: Соединять уже поддержанные методы в один новый вопрос
causal_optional_growth.new_question: Можно ли ответить на stochastic policy с proxy confounding и административной missingness, когда ни одна отдельная ветка не покрывает весь вопрос?
causal_optional_growth.first_case: Минимальная двуслойная композиция с явной общей joint model и exact target: recovery plus identified policy, или proximal plus one mediator.
causal_optional_growth.second_case: Другой механизм зависимости, источник либо transported policy, который нельзя закрыть переименованием того же synthetic fixture.
causal_optional_growth.data_and_nondata_requirements: Совместное отношение наблюдений и assumptions между branches, compatible support, binding of recovered factors/bridges/policy; individual stage certificates не доказывают composition.
causal_optional_growth.reuse_and_consumer: Canonical proof and estimator compiler owners, no parallel causal engine. Expected E02 fixes supply usable IR/served-chain correctness; remaining mathematics assessed separately.
causal_optional_growth.simple_comparator_and_controls: Manual symbolic derivation + strongest existing composed method; positive scoped composition, negative incompatible assumptions/target and false join.
causal_optional_growth.stop_or_defer: Начать с established theorem/reduction if available. Если нужна новая теорема, оставить scoped FrontierSketch until payoff and falsifier justify work; не делать все four compound examples обязательными.
causal_optional_growth.effort_boundary: No unconditional schedule or measured speed claim. First inspect existing owner and frozen input; charge E02 repair/shared substrate once. Scientific qualification and external waits separate from integration work.

mathematical_scope_checks.observed_claim: A bound on false positive simple certification is inferred from Type-I bounds on rejecting the witness null.
mathematical_scope_checks.finding: The implication is invalid without additional power or separation premises.
mathematical_scope_checks.explicit_counterexample: A test that never rejects has Type-I error 0 under every true null. Under any false null it nevertheless accepts with probability 1. Therefore a Type-I bound alpha alone cannot upper-bound false acceptance by alpha.
mathematical_scope_checks.scope: This refutes that inference, not the usefulness of consistency triage or all possible future certification procedures. Current runtime implementation was not audited for this rule.
mathematical_scope_checks.planning_effect: Require an independently justified meaning for positive certification in any deployed diagnostic profile; do not mandate a universal three-way classifier research program.

mathematical_scope_checks.observed_claim: The proposed completeness argument treats descendant exclusion and backdoor d-separation as necessary and sufficient for general valid covariate adjustment.
mathematical_scope_checks.finding: The broad necessity inference is too strong; a narrower backdoor subclass can remain valid.
mathematical_scope_checks.explicit_counterexample: Let X, U_Y, U_Z be independent Bernoulli variables, with all probabilities strictly between 0 and 1. Let Y=X XOR U_Y and Z=X XOR U_Z. The DAG is X→Y and X→Z. Z is a descendant of X, but Y is independent of Z conditional on X, so sum_z P(Y|X=x,Z=z)P(Z=z)=P(Y|X=x)=P(Y|do(X=x)). Adjustment by Z is valid here although a blanket descendant-exclusion check rejects it.
mathematical_scope_checks.scope: This challenges only the broader adjustment-completeness argument. It neither establishes an error in the present exact_observed_dag_adjustment_v1 implementation nor invalidates a deliberately narrower declared backdoor scope.
mathematical_scope_checks.planning_effect: Read the exact owner’s scope before relying on a completeness claim; do not count broader completeness as an automatic development obligation.

mathematical_scope_checks.observed_claim: Support enumeration O(n^k poly(n)) is called FPT in k; enumeration is used as evidence of general hardness.
mathematical_scope_checks.finding: That upper bound is polynomial for fixed k (XP form), not itself FPT. An expensive enumeration is not a lower-bound proof.
mathematical_scope_checks.explicit_counterexample: By definition an FPT bound is f(k) n^c with c independent of k. The displayed exponent k is not such a bound; another algorithm could still be FPT.
mathematical_scope_checks.scope: Terminology correction only. No current runtime complexity or NP-hardness claim was independently proved/refuted.
mathematical_scope_checks.planning_effect: Use instance measurements and exact supported solver scope; do not budget from historical asymptotic labels.
